macros.name: letdif
macros.doc: Through the \letdif command, we can redefine a math character command by its name.

macros.name: letdif*
macros.doc: Through the \letdif command, we can redefine a math character command by its name.

macros.name: newdif
macros.doc: \newdif and \newdif* will check whether ⟨cmd⟩ has been defined already. If so, an error message will be given.

macros.name: newdif*
macros.doc: \newdif and \newdif* will check whether ⟨cmd⟩ has been defined already. If so, an error message will be given.
